lq.ANSWER: Practice Session 7 helps us reflect on whether human beings are playing their role properly in nature. The main learning is that nature already has an inherent order, and the role of human beings is to understand this harmony and live without violating it. Human participation should facilitate the activity, innateness and inheritance of all orders of nature. For the physical order, we must help maintain its constitution; for the bio order, we must support growth and protect seeds; for the animal order, we must ensure an environment for its body and breed; and for the human order, we must support right understanding, human education-sanskar, undivided society and universal human order. Environmental crisis shows that when human beings act without right understanding, they disturb harmony. Therefore, this session leads us to responsible participation in nature.
